Source: TLE42754 datasheet Rev. 1.31 (2023-11-27), https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/10/49/infineon-tle42754-datasheet-en.pdf, read 2026-09-29T03:14:06Z. Output voltage: VQ 4.9 to 5.1 V for 1 mA < IQ < 400 mA and 6 V < VI < 28 V, over Tj -40 to 150 °C (P_5.1.2), which covers 6.0 to 22 V. Two limits apply. First, 6.0 V is the open end of '6 V < VI'. Second, loads below 1 mA are not specified. P2's rank 2 TPS7B8250 has the same 1 mA floor (IOUT = 1 mA to 300 mA, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps7b82-q1.pdf read 03:14:49Z), and so does its rank 3 TPS7B8150 (IOUT = 1 mA to 150 mA, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps7b81.pdf read 03:14:50Z). P2 passed both against 'load 0 to 60 mA'. Input: functional range 5.5 to 42 V (P_4.2.1). Dropout: at most 500 mV at 300 mA (P_5.1.7), so at most 1.0 V at 60 mA holds. Protection: current limit 450 to 1100 mA (P_5.1.4) and overtemperature shutdown at 151 to 200 °C (P_5.1.10). Junction temperature: Tj max 150 °C (P_4.2.4). Current consumption is at most 220 µA at 1 mA and 85 °C (P_5.2.2) and at most 10 mA at 250 mA (P_5.2.3). No figure is given at 60 mA. Taking the 250 mA maximum as the bound, which holds only if Iq rises with load as the typical curve shows, gives Pd ≤ 17 V × 60 mA + 22 V × 10 mA = 1.24 W. RthJA is 27 K/W on a 2s2p board (P_4.3.2), giving Tj ≤ 83.5 °C at 50 °C ambient. On 1s0p with 300 mm² it is 57 K/W (P_4.3.4), giving 120.7 °C. On the bare footprint it is 110 K/W (P_4.3.3), giving 186 °C, which fails, so the part needs at least 300 mm² of copper or a 2s2p board. Circuit: CQ at least 22 µF with ESR at most 3 Ω (P_4.2.2, P_4.2.3). RO and D are left open when the reset is not needed (Table 1).
